title: Whoop athletes
description: A big display heading and paragraph over a two-row wall of small landscape photo cards with 11px corners, each carrying a person's name in bold and their role in white with a tiny round plus. On phones the two rows scroll sideways together, snapping column by column with the next column peeking; on desktop they settle into a four-by-two grid. Photos zoom in a touch on hover.
notes: names sit on the photos in the background colour, over a shade placeholder that darkens with the theme's foreground
